comment: Dr Dominey is smart, but too smart for his own good. Our lab that was for a gen ed science went past the three hours every time because he gave a longgg lecture before we could start. I would rather ask the lab aid for help on a question because if you asked him something simple he would spend 5 minutes explaining before getting to his point

Saint, very knowledgeable and interesting but can't lecture. Attests to the importance of common language in science and I think he's right to do so, but he himself doesn't have the linguistic dexterity to drive home the focus on semantics. Occasional circular justifications and mere gestures toward drawings with questions. We're just 111 tho tbf.

Dominey is a great guy once you get to know him, but his lectures can be super boring because of his monotonous voice. The material he lectures on can all be reviewed through screencasts and the textbook, so you don't really have to pay attention. Despite his teaching abilities, he genuinely cares about his students and tries his best.

I took Solving World Problems (CHEM 111) for my science gen ed and it was really a mistake. For the majority of the semester, my classmates and I were generally lost. Dominey gets super excited about chem, which only makes him go too fast. What seems like "logic" to him starts to sound like gibberish to us. I only recommend to people good at chem.

Dr. Dominey is the nicest lab teacher at Richmond. He is accommodating and willing to go the extra mile to ensure that you succeed. While sometimes before lab he does talk for a while, he is only trying to make sure concepts are clear and make the lab easier. He is a gracious grader and will work with you outside of class. I definitely recommend!

Its obvious that he cares about students. Hes willing to go out of his way to meet with you if you ask, even on the weekends or at night. The best thing about this class for me was that it seemed like he just wanted us to become more confident and comfortable speaking about science. Its an awesome class to take as a science gen ed.

He wants to see his students succeed, but he's too smart to be able to teach in a way that doesn't just drone on sometimes. I literally am obsessed with science and even I get bored listening to him talk. Take if you're interested in actually being good with the machines, but get ready to sit through 3 hour lectures in lab. Still a really nice guy.

Only take this class if you were like me and had a lot of time during your freshman year fall semester to devote to this class and you don't totally abhor science. This class was difficult because Professor Dominey is super intelligent and assumes that his students are as intelligent as him. He knows the material, but doesn't know how to teach.

If I had written this two months ago, it would have been a lot more negative. But the fact is, Dominey can't really teach basic chem to students who have no idea what he is talking about. If you need this class for a gen-ed, skip it. Take bio. But he really does try to help as much as he can and he's a really nice guy. Just incredibly confusing.
Very unclear in his lectures, but if you show initiative and take advantage of his office hours he will go out of his way to help you pass the class.
He is really nice. He wants his students to learn and understand the material. He is willing to help with questions. He loves what he teaches!!
He really wants his students to learn and understand the material. He is willing to help with questions. He is very nice and really likes what he teaches.

Awful!  This class could be great if taught by someone else.  Wait to take this course with someone other than Dominey.  Tests are all out of class - each test is like a final exam though.  Work is graded very slowly- you don't have a good sense of how you are doing in the class until the very end.

Great teacher. Tests are suuuper hard and his lectures are boring and lengthy but he really care about the students and is passionate about the subject matter. Be prepared to work hard, but he is more than willing to help outside of class. Great guy!
Dominey is the man...yes, lab writeups are a pain, but that's a department issue. Overall, he does his best to make lab enjoyable, and will go out of his way to give help if you ask for it.

A very cool guy, has worked at los alamos. He's fun to talk to after lab, and always takes ample time to go over what you'll do. Really helpful and clear in almost every way possible. If you put in effort, you'll do well in lab.

terrible. his lectures are exremely irrelevant ot anything on the tests and he attempts to teach extrememyl advanced topics in an intro course. avoid this class at all costs, even if it means taking an 8:15.

Professor Dominey is the most helpful professor/teacher I have ever had.  I would study outside his office before the test, and he would help me any time within the 6 or so hours I would be there.  If you grab a hold of his conceptual teaching style, you will do well in the class.  If you just try to memorize problems, you will not do as well.

I hate this guy. He's nice outside of class, but his lectures are SO irrelevant and he is so unclear. Be prepared to teach yourself everything because nothing you get from him is helpful. His tests are impossible and he doesn't get through half of the material you need for 205. I wouldn't take a class with him again if my life depended on it

He tries very hard to be a good teacher, but he just isn't.  If you do the reading and problem sets it's possible to do okay in the class, especially if you try hard in lab.  I would, however, recommend a teacher other than Dominey unless you are very good at teaching things to yourself.

not a bad class for the science requirement.  problem sets are most of the work which he helps with.  lectures a little irrelevant at times but you're not responsible for that material.  nice guy overall, helpful.  im not a science person so it worked fine for me.
horrible
This guy sucks. DEFINITELY get Myers instead of you can. He sucks at explaining things and you have to really, really understand the concepts in order to pass. Just don't do it to yourself...
Very helpful -  but sooooo difficult to understand.
great
not overly difficult. extremely nice teacher but class is insanely boring. if you dont go make sure you know what youre doing or hell tell the dean on you
Bad

His class demands your conceptual understanding and the way he explains things is very confusing. He needs you to explain things really well for him to give full credit. It is a very hard course if you don't study really well.
like the person said before, he is a really great guy, but he just doesnt teach well unless you love reading the book :(
aweful!  the nicest guy - but not a good teacher.
No Comments
If you're taking CHEM 141 try to get Myers or Goldman instead!
